beat.boundaryReason: The opening recalls the previous night's egg vision, then frames all four childhood memories as reflections on waking on the Wanderer's palm. Keep these linked recollections together. The current morning is clarified as about nine or ten at u0225; no calendar date is known. At u0313 the DM explicitly resumes the restaurant conversation and present-day action.
